title: Travel & instances
summary: City routes, rings, spires, waypoints and private dungeon runs.
body:
Ten city routes with return books

Speak to Merrin in the tunnel for ten city destinations. Return books bring you back to the shared hub.

Druid Ring travel

Khalure offers the currently available Classic Druid Rings. Some routes and client installations still need checks. Report silent travel or missing-world failures to the owner.

Wizard Spire travel

Khaleid offers eight Classic Wizard Spire destinations from the tunnel travel area.

A Plane of Knowledge connection

A dedicated travel connection keeps the Plane of Knowledge reachable alongside the tunnel’s city routes.

Nightcap Recall

Make a hotkey for Ancient Attunement in the General abilities tab. It returns you to the tunnel with a five-second cast and ten-minute reuse, preserving your bind point and other home destinations. Its cooldown is now separate from unrelated activated AAs such as Rampage and Purify Body; existing waits retain their expiry.

Travel to places you have discovered

Find waypoint markers to unlock return destinations with the Waypoint Master. Discovering them all is a custom exploration quest.

Private dungeon runs

Instance Keepers offer all 21 Classic combat dungeons, including Fear, Hate and Sky. Hail to choose Raid or Grind, enter, or join your group leader; use #instances for open runs and timers. Runs last 12 hours. Only the creator can confirm a reset, with no players, pending entries or recoverable corpses inside. Earned reward claims and permanent completion counts survive reset and expiry. The small floating-eye Keeper is separate from the waypoint portal.

Live testing: Raid and Grind dungeon modes are available from all 21 dungeon Keepers. Existing legacy runs keep their original behavior until expiry or reset. Gameplay and balance acceptance remain open.

The Vigil of the Dawn — live testing

A dedicated Keeper near Befallen in West Commonlands opens Chapterhouse expeditions. The zone uses a scoped level-50 exception; Classic remains the global era. Exits return to West Commonlands. Read the quest guide and reward catalog.

Entering The Hole

In Paineel, click the entrance rock at /loc 568,-896,-96. The passage needs neither The Hole Key nor lock picks. Paineel city-lift keys and Sacred Key doors inside The Hole keep their own requirements. This entrance change is installed for live testing.

Missing zone files

Close EverQuest and use the normal launcher’s Play flow to check managed zone files. See zone loading help if a destination still fails.

This update is in Change Log →

The Ashen Compact — live testing

The Ashen Compact is an installed level-50 Shadow Knight helmet campaign in a curated Kael expedition. Its paired server and client release is available for testing; full encounter, rendering and balance acceptance remain open.

Drazhul and the Kael Keeper stand together in the hidden Everfrost passage before Permafrost. The public Kael foyer contains services; its Keeper controls private runs. The scoped exception does not unlock Velious globally.

Returning to a saved zone or dungeon

After a saved zone or managed run reloads, stationary NPCs retain their original home points. They can resume at their saved positions and return home normally; the correction does not teleport them away or prevent new aggro. Roaming NPCs keep their existing behavior.
